body:
## Block printed kurtis, made where the craft was born

Sanganer, on the edge of Jaipur, has been the home of hand block printing for centuries. Our unit is right here, so we work directly with local printers and our own stitching team. That keeps quality in our hands and prices fair for our buyers.

## What we manufacture

- Straight, A-line, Anarkali and kaftan style **kurtis**
- **Kurta sets** with pant, palazzo and dupatta
- Block printed **dresses** – maxi, midi and short
- **Co-ord sets**, tops and tunics

Popular prints include Sanganeri florals, Bagru, Dabu (mud resist), indigo and Ajrakh-inspired designs. Fabrics include cotton, cambric, mulmul, rayon and linen blends.

## Who we work with

- **Boutiques and retailers** buying ready designs in mixed sizes
- **Online sellers** on Amazon, Myntra, Etsy and their own websites
- **Fashion brands** that want production under their own label
- **Importers** in the USA, UK, Europe, Australia and the Middle East

## Why buyers choose Bahe Kurtiz

1. Direct manufacturer – no middleman
2. Photos and videos of your goods before dispatch
3. Small boutique orders welcome; repeat orders get priority
4. GST registered business; export orders shipped with proper invoices

## How to order

Send us the styles, fabric, quantity and sizes you need. We share a catalogue and a written quotation. Production starts after sample approval and advance payment. [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) or use the [wholesale enquiry form](/wholesale/#enquiry).

faq.q: Are your kurtis really hand block printed?
faq.a: We make both hand block printed and screen printed styles. Every product page mentions the print type so you know exactly what you are buying.

faq.q: What is your minimum order quantity?
faq.a: It depends on the design and fabric. Small boutique orders are welcome. Message us on WhatsApp with your requirement and we will tell you the minimum for those styles.
